lede: The day's web had one clear center of gravity: Israel's coming election. The 2026 Israeli legislative election drew 438,729 views to lead Wikipedia, and on Polymarket three of the top five markets, Netanyahu's path to prime minister among them, turned on that same vote. The only other story to cross feeds was far smaller: Trail Blazers vs. Lakers surfaced on both Google Trends and Polymarket. Everything else stayed inside its own corner of the internet.

throughlines.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
throughlines.gist: The election led Wikipedia with 438,729 views and anchored several Polymarket markets at once, the rare story pulling in both readers and bettors.

throughlines.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
throughlines.gist: The top-ranked market on Polymarket today, asking whether the vote returns Netanyahu to the prime minister's office.

throughlines.title: Trail Blazers vs. Lakers
throughlines.gist: An NBA game that showed up as both a Google Trends search and a Polymarket market, one of the few stories to cross feeds today.
